summary: EVI Industries, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting amendments to two asset purchase agreements dated July 17, 2026, whereby its indirect subsidiary Garment Care Services FL, LLC acquires assets of Sudsies On-Site and personal goodwill of Jason Loeb from the seller group. The amendments change consideration to all cash: $900,000 for the Sudsies On-Site assets (previously $800k cash plus $100k stock) and $7,124,778 for Loeb's personal goodwill (previously $6,624,778 cash plus $500k stock). No advisors, board recommendation, or premium mentioned. Watch for working capital adjustments and closing conditions under the amended agreements.
